children: Italy's Treasury said on Friday it would offer a new BTP bond dedicated to retail investors, as it tries to increase small investors' holdings of its domestic debt.
The dual-tranche issue, with a five-year maturity, will be offered from October 19 to 23.
For the first time, two different BTP Valore bond will be offered simultaneously and can be purchased either separately or together.
